title: Foundations of AI & Mental Models
subtitle: Understand how pattern recognition differs from traditional coding with the pocket analogizer.

hero.heading: So, What actually is AI?
hero.intro: Artificial Intelligence — the capability of computer systems to perform tasks that historically required human thinking or reasoning — is not an independent thinking creature. Instead, it is a tool that detects recurring structures in huge sets of data.

analogy.label: A Simple Analogy
analogy.text: It’s just like teaching a child what a 'dog' is. You don't hand them a legal brief explaining animal biology. You show them thousands of dogs in real life until their brain naturally links the floppy ears, tails, and sizes together.

patternMatcher.title: The Pattern Matcher
patternMatcher.subtitle: Data goes in, patterns are discovered, decisions come out.

pocketExamples.title: AI in Your Pocket
pocketExamples.subtitle: You probably use AI multiple times a day without even noticing. Here are six everyday examples of how AI processes patterns behind the scenes.
pocketExamples.hint: Tap any card to reveal how it works under the hood.

items.title: Netflix Predictions
items.explanation: Instead of choosing blindly, it compares your exact viewing history with millions of other users to spot similar taste patterns.

items.title: Google Maps ETA
items.explanation: Looks at historical road congestion alongside real-time speeds of active drivers to forecast your arrival down to the minute.

items.title: ChatGPT responses
items.explanation: A program that has digested massive libraries of human text, letting it predict the most helpful next word in a sentence.

items.title: Voice Assistants
items.explanation: Translates sound waves of spoken words into text commands, mapping them to software actions like setting an alarm.

items.title: Spam Filtering
items.explanation: Scans text files for warning words or sender patterns to filter out unwanted messages before they hit your view.

items.title: Photo Face-grouping
items.explanation: Finds unique geometry in facial structures, grouping photos of the same individual together automatically.

threeHorizons.title: The Three Horizons of AI
threeHorizons.subtitle: Scientists divide AI into three major stages based on what the machines can actually achieve.

items.title: Narrow AI
items.description: Systems designed to master just one specific task, like playing chess or recommending music. Every single AI system in operation today is Narrow AI.

items.title: General AI
items.description: A theoretical system with human-level intelligence that can learn and apply knowledge to any problem. It does not exist yet.

items.title: Super AI
items.description: A hypothetical machine that surpasses human brain capacity in every dimension, from logical analysis to social empathy.
